description:
A successful candidate must be comfortable in UNIX shell and in scripting languages such as Python, Perl, Ruby or PowerShell, with 10 years of programming  
 5 years backend experience including SQL development  
 must have been a significant party in multiple successful enterprise project deliveries.  
 Experience with object databases and Netezza are preferred.  
 At this level, the candidate should expect to participate in negotiations with high-level stakeholders and help keep the team processes robust, including test-driven development and source code control practices.  
 The candidate will be responsible for mapping user requirements to system requirements, system requirements to technical specifications, and specs to functionality.  
 She or he will be expected to review code, provide consulting to developers on other projects and mentor more junior staff.  
 The candidate may infrequently be called upon to perform off-hours support. No travel.. 

 Bachelor's or higher Degree is Preferred 

 Job Status: Full Time  
 
 
 Eligiblity: GC or US Citizens 
 
 Share the Profiles to mkonni(at)1stitsolutions.com 

 
 Contact: 703-349-1214 
 
 
 Keep the subject line with Job Title and Location
